exam: 2021年6月 第2套 · 仔细阅读 P1
title: Sugar shocked.…

sents.en: That describes the reaction of many Americans this week following revelations that, 50 years ago, the sugar industry paid Harvard scientists for research that shifted the focus away from sugar's role in heart disease and put the spotlight squarely on dietary fat.
sents.cn: 这形容了本周许多美国人的反应——此前有爆料称，50年前，糖业协会曾出资让哈佛科学家做研究，把焦点从糖在心脏病中的作用上移开，并径直对准膳食脂肪。

sents.en: What might surprise consumers is just how many present-day nutrition studies are still funded by the food industry.
sents.cn: 或许让消费者意外的是，当今仍有如此多营养学研究由食品行业资助。

sents.en: Nutrition scholar Marion Nestle of New York University spent a year informally tracking industry-funded studies on food.
sents.cn: 纽约大学营养学者玛丽昂∙内斯特尔花了一年时间，非正式地追踪食品行业资助的研究。

sents.en: "Roughly 90% of nearly 170 studies favored the sponsor's interest," Nestle tells us.
sents.cn: "在近170项研究中，约90%都偏向资助方的利益，"内斯特尔告诉我们。

sents.en: Other systematic reviews support her conclusions.
sents.cn: 其他系统性综述也支持她的结论。

sents.en: For instance, studies funded by Welch Foods·the brand behind Welch's 100% Grape Juice· found that drinking Concord grape juice daily may boost brain function.
sents.cn: 例如，由Welch's100%葡萄汁背后的品牌WelchFoods资助的研究发现，每天饮用康科德葡萄汁可能提升脑功能。

sents.en: Another, funded by Quaker Oats, concluded, as a Daily Mail story put it, that "hot oatmeal breakfast keeps you full for longer." Last year, The New York Times revealed how Coca-Cola was funding well-known scientists and organizations promoting a message that, in the battle against weight gain, people should pay more attention to exercise and less to what they eat and drink. Coca-Cola also released data detailing its funding of several medical institutions and associations between 2010 and 2015.
sents.cn: 另一项由桂格燕麦资助的研究得出结论称（据《每日邮报》报道），"热燕麦片早餐让你更久饱腹"。去年，《纽约时报》披露了可口可乐如何资助知名科学家和组织，推动这样一种讯息：在对抗体重增加的战斗中，人们应更关注运动，而非吃喝。可口可乐还公布了其在2010至2015年间资助多家医疗机构和协会的详细数据。

sents.en: "It's certainly a problem that so much research in nutrition and health is funded by industry," says Bonnie Liebman, director of nutrition at the Center for Science in the Public Interest.
sents.cn: "在营养与健康领域，如此多的研究由行业资助，这当然是个问题，"公共利益科学中心营养总监邦尼∙利布曼说，"当食品行业为研究买单时，它往往能得到它所付钱换来的东西。

sents.en: "When the food industry pays for research, it often gets what it pays for." And what it pays for is often a pro-industry finding.
sents.cn: "而它付钱换来的，往往是一个偏向行业的研究结论。

sents.en: Given this environment, consumers should be skeptical when reading the latest finding in nutrition science and ignore the latest study that pops up on your news feed.
sents.cn: 鉴于这种环境，消费者在阅读营养科学的最新发现时应当保持怀疑，并忽略新闻推送中冒出来的最新研究。

sents.en: "Rely on health experts who've reviewed all the evidence," Liebman says, pointing to the official government Dietary Guidelines, which are based on reviews of hundreds of studies.
sents.cn: "信赖那些审阅过全部证据的健康专家，"利布曼说，并指向基于数百项研究综述的政府官方《膳食指南

sents.en: 》。 "And that expert advice remains pretty simple," says Nestle.
sents.cn: "而专家的建议其实相当简单，"内斯特尔说，"我们知道什么是健康饮食——大量蔬菜、别吃太多垃圾食品、热量均衡。

sents.en: "We know what healthy diets are·lots of vegetables, not too much junk food, balanced calories.
sents.cn: 其余的一切，在实验上都很难以做到。

sents.en: Everything else is really difficult to do experimentally."
